aboutHtml:
We're Graham and Sue Randall, and we've built STIHL SHOP Huntly as the place locals come for outdoor power equipment that works hard and lasts. We stock STIHL's full range of chainsaws, trimmers, and lawn care gear, and we know every machine we sell.

We do more than just sell equipment. We service what we stock, keep parts on hand, and take time to help you choose what's right for your work. Whether you're running a farm, contracting, or keeping your property tidy, we'll help you find the gear that fits.

Come and see us. We're open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, and Saturday and Sunday from 9am to noon.
